# Updated Worker Node Configuration

`dev/workers.yaml`
```yaml
# Dev worker node group: 3 nodes, t3.medium (scaled from 2)
apiVersion: cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: MachineDeployment
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  clusterName: myapp-dev
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      cluster.x-k8s.io/cluster-name: myapp-dev
  template:
    spec:
      clusterName: myapp-dev
      version: v1.31.2
      bootstrap:
        configRef:
          apiVersion: bootstrap.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
          kind: KubeadmConfig
          name: myapp-dev-workers
      infrastructureRef:
        apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
        kind: AWSMachineTemplate
        name: myapp-dev-workers
---
apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: AWSMachineTemplate
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      instanceType: t3.medium
      instanceProfile: nodes
```

`prod/workers.yaml`
```yaml
# Prod worker node group: 6 nodes, t3.large (scaled from 4)
apiVersion: cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: MachineDeployment
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  clusterName: myapp-prod
  replicas: 6
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      cluster.x-k8s.io/cluster-name: myapp-prod
  template:
    spec:
      clusterName: myapp-prod
      version: v1.31.2
      bootstrap:
        configRef:
          apiVersion: bootstrap.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
          kind: KubeadmConfig
          name: myapp-prod-workers
      infrastructureRef:
        apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
        kind: AWSMachineTemplate
        name: myapp-prod-workers
---
apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: AWSMachineTemplate
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      instanceType: t3.large
      instanceProfile: nodes
```

**Changes made:**
- `dev/workers.yaml`: `myapp-dev-workers` MachineDeployment replicas `2` → `3`
- `prod/workers.yaml`: `myapp-prod-workers` MachineDeployment replicas `4` → `6`
- Instance types unchanged: `t3.medium` (dev), `t3.large` (prod)
- Both files updated independently (no base/overlay sharing)

Apply with: `kubectl apply -f dev/ && kubectl apply -f prod/`
